comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 3
Consumed Gauge: 90
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 60

It requires two/three seconds before the Tech will be used.
With advanture job this Tech needs only one second till it activates.

Effect:
Aside from damage, your target(s) get "Laceration" status and loses 20 stamina per second. Moreover, the attack power of the enemies are reduced by 25% at "Laceration" This effect last for at least 20 seconds. Higher Trap prolongs the "Laceration" -effect.

I've learned this from "Colorado Bandit lv40" at Colorado Plateau after he used this Tech against me.
